LuxReplayChara_Tick_CopyNextFrameToManager_SetMoveState4(ALuxBattleFrameInputLog* pInputLog)
============================================================================
ALuxBattleReplayPlayer's UE4 Actor::Tick override (vtable[131] = +0x418
in vtable @ 0x143290718).  Per-UE4-frame snapshot copier that drives
visual replay playback (Strategy A in HorseMod scrub design).

==========================================================================
GATING CONDITION (load-bearing for HorseMod scrub-resume, 2026-05-14)
==========================================================================
After AActor_TickActor, resolves pBM and pPlayerRecordArray =
pBM->PlayerRecordsBase_at0x440.  Reads two PlayerField uints:
  pra+0x394   pPlayerFieldAt394 (auxiliary flags - currently unused here)
  pra+0x398   dwReplayDirectionBits
              bit 8 (0x100)  = REWIND requested
              bit 9 (0x200)  = FORWARD requested

If pInputLog->bEnable_at0x398 != 0 AND BM status == 2:
  if (rewind bit set) AND cursor > 0:           cursor--
  else if (forward bit set) AND cursor <= total: cursor++
  else (NEITHER bit set):                        return early - NO ADVANCE

If cursor advanced AND in [0, nTotalRecordedFrames]:
  memcpy 192 bytes from pRecordedFrameBuffer[cursor*0xC0] -> BM+0x1360
  SetMoveState(4)  // triggers HandleStageInitPhase to dispatch snapshot

==========================================================================
HORSEMOD SCRUB-RESUME FAILURE (THE ACTUAL CAUSE, 2026-05-14)
==========================================================================
Per the 21:47 session log diagnostic dump:
  POST_SEEK PRA P0[+394=0x0 +398=0x0] P1[+394=0x0 +398=0x0]

Both forward AND rewind bits clear post-seek.  Function early-returns
every frame.  BM+0x1360 never gets new snapshot copied.  HandleStage-
InitPhase has nothing to dispatch.  Chara MoveVM finishes whichever
move was loaded at the snapshot frame (because chara state was correctly
restored) then idles because no new MoveState=4 dispatch arrives.

User-observed symptom matches exactly: "the state seems correct to when
I select, its just that the replay doesnt play from the point I
selected afterwards. Characters seem to finish whatever move they were
executing and then stand still."

==========================================================================
WHO SETS PRA+0x398 BIT 9 IN NORMAL REPLAY VIEWING
==========================================================================
Per LuxBattleManager_GetPlayerFieldAt398_Stride0xa8 @ 0x1403F0B70, these
are PlayerField bits read from pra+(playerIndex*0xa8)+0x398.  The
PlayerField is written by UE4's input pipeline based on the user's
controller input.  In replay viewing the bits are SET BY THE BLUEPRINT-
LEVEL REPLAY MENU when the user holds the forward / rewind input or
when the menu logic considers replay playback active.

HorseMod's pause/play UI flip is independent of these bits.  When
HorseMod scrub un-pauses, it removes the WorldTickGate freeze but
does NOT set the forward bit, so this function still early-returns
even though the world is otherwise unpaused.

Fix: either
  (a) Capture pra+0x394/+0x398 per-snapshot and restore on seek
      (preserves whatever bit pattern was natural at the captured frame)
  (b) Force bit 9 = 1 on un-pause when the HorseMod state is "playing"
The HorseMod ReplayScrub extras blob now does (a) - see
horselib/ReplayScrub.hpp::capture_extras / restore_extras.
